title: EventCohortCountsDocument
description: Server-only booking totals by cohort for one event, at eventCohortCounts/{eventId}. A cohort (menInterestedInWomen, womenInterestedInMen, queerOrOpen, nonBinaryOrOther) encodes gender and who a guest is interested in, and on a small event a per-cohort total can point to one person's orientation. Organisers read events/{eventId}, so the totals the admission policy needs live here (#2493). Gender totals stay on the event. No client and no organiser reads it.
x-owner: events-owned counter writes (functions/src/domain/events/eventDocumentWrites.ts), in the transaction of each booking, waitlist, offer or pair-hold command

crossPathsPairHeldCohortCounts.description: Cross Paths pair holds by the requester's cohort.
